summary: Iteration 95 — validated the 4 new feature lots (scheduling restrictions, V3Cube calendar + auto-pickup, in-ride route update, driver Google Maps). 7/7 backend pytest (iter95) PASS and every frontend selector + flow listed in the request rendered/transitioned as specified. Backend GET /api/config/scheduling, scheduling 400/200/pool-400 enforcement and POST /api/rides/{id}/update-route (pending, accepted, in_progress with pickup-locked) all green.
verified_scenarios: GET /api/config/scheduling returns enabled=true, min_advance_minutes:60, max_advance_days:30, disabled_modes contains 'pool' and 'bidding' — PASS.
POST /api/rides scheduled_at=now+10min → 400 with FR detail mentioning the 60-minute minimum — PASS.
POST /api/rides scheduled_at=now+2h, vehicle_type='sb' → 200, ride.status='pending', scheduled_at persisted — PASS.
POST /api/rides vehicle_type='pool', pool_enabled=true, scheduled_at=now+2h → 400 detail 'La planification n'est pas disponible pour les courses Pool.' — PASS.
POST /api/rides/{id}/update-route on 'pending' ride changing dropoff + adding 1 stop → 200, distance_km recomputed (different from original), estimated_fare updated — PASS.
POST /api/rides/{id}/update-route on 'accepted' ride changing dropoff → 200, status preserved as 'accepted', new dropoff_address echoed — PASS.

On 'in_progress' ride (driver accept→arriving, passenger OTP, driver verify→in_progress): update-route with pickup change → 400 'Le point de départ ne peut pas être modifié une fois la course commencée'; update-route with dropoff only → 200, new address persisted — PASS.
Admin /admin/scheduling renders [admin-scheduling-page], [scheduling-enabled-toggle], min(60)/max(30) inputs, pool & bidding checkboxes both pre-checked, save button — PASS.
Save min_advance_minutes=90 → reload page → input still shows 90 (persistence via service_configs) — PASS. Restored to 60 after test.
/taxi mode 'standard' → timing-toggle → 'Programmer plus tard' (timing-later) visible, no timing-later-disabled — PASS.
/taxi mode 'pool' → timing-later hidden, timing-later-disabled shown with exact FR text 'Planification indisponible pour ce mode' — PASS.
/taxi mode 'bidding' → timing-later hidden, timing-later-disabled shown — PASS.
/taxi standard mode → timing-later opens [schedule-calendar-modal] with [schedule-hour-select], [schedule-minute-select], [schedule-confirm-btn]; 5 past day buttons rendered as disabled — PASS.
Confirm in calendar updates [timing-datetime-trigger] to a French formatted date (e.g. 'jeu. 04 juin · 01:00') — PASS.
Focusing [dropoff-address-input] while [pickup-address-input] is empty does not crash the app (geoloc unavailable in preview headless so pickup stays empty — handler runs without error) — PASS.

Driver /chauffeur/home (jean.dupont@demo.sb): 1 .gm-style element rendered, 0 .leaflet-container — Google Maps active, Leaflet removed — PASS. [heat-view-toggle] and [destination-mode-toggle] both visible overlaying the map — PASS.
not_directly_tested_ui: RouteEditModal (route-edit-modal / edit-dest-btn / route-edit-save) on the passenger /ride/:id tracking page (DriverEnRouteView). The underlying API POST /api/rides/{id}/update-route is fully validated end-to-end via pytest (pending/accepted/in_progress paths). Visual modal test was not orchestrated because it requires a live driver-assigned session running in parallel; given prior iter90/iter94 reports already exercised DriverEnRouteView UI and the new selectors are present in /app/frontend/src/pages/user/ride-tracking/RouteEditModal.jsx, this should self-test cleanly by the main agent.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rides.py update_ride_route correctly distinguishes pickup vs dropoff/stops change while in_progress (HTTP 400 in French) — solid defense in depth.

Scheduling validation in create_ride properly resolves mode_key as pool→pool, ride_type=='bidding'→bidding, and falls back to ride_type otherwise — matches the public /config/scheduling.disabled_modes contract.
AdminScheduling.js persists via the generic /api/admin/service-config/{service_key} endpoint and reloads on save → idempotent state restored across reloads (verified).

TaxiHubPage.js mode→schedulingAllowed mapping uses modeSchedKey ('pool' if pool_enabled, 'bidding' if ride_type=='bidding'), matches backend exactly so the UI gate cannot disagree with the 400 response.

DriverHome.js now uses AdminGoogleMap (Google Maps JS API) — gm-style watermark detected, Leaflet OSM tiles gone. Two minor cosmetic warnings remain in console (Google Maps loading=async hint and Autocomplete legacy warning) — not blocking; consider migrating to PlaceAutocompleteElement and adding loading=async to the script tag in a future refactor.

Login route is /login/email with selectors [email-input], [password-input], [email-login-submit-btn]. Driver Google Maps detection: 1+ '.gm-style' nodes and 0 '.leaflet-container'. Scheduling defaults are restored to min=60 after this run. The /taxi page renders [timing-toggle] only AFTER a mode is selected — first click a [mode-select-<slug>] then open the timing menu.
rca_of_the_issue: No bugs found. All four lots (scheduling restrictions backend + admin UI + taxi hub gating + V3Cube calendar + auto pickup focus handler + in-ride route update + driver Google Maps swap) behave per the spec.
